title: JFK assassination linked to the UAP topic, read from Kash Patel's remarks

tellings.quote: But what I hear him saying cryptically is that the JFK assassination is linked to the UAP topic.

plain: Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot, says that when Kash Patel, a US official, speaks about the government's files on the 1963 killing of President John F. Kennedy in Dallas, Barber hears him hinting that the assassination is linked to UAP, the government's term for UFOs. If that reading were right, Kennedy's death would be tied to the UFO secret.
